title: anthriscus sylvestris subsp. alpina
intro: Anthriscus sylvestris subsp. alpina, commonly known as Wild Chervil, is a perennial plant species within the carrot family (Apiaceae) that grows in mountainous regions. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. Wild Chervil's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and act as an antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory agent. The plant's bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
